name: Ainok Strike Leader
oracle_text:
Whenever you attack with this creature and/or your commander, for each opponent, create a 1/1 red Goblin creature token that's tapped and attacking that player.
Sacrifice this creature: Creature tokens you control gain indestructible until end of turn.
blocked_sentences: Whenever you attack with this creature and/or your commander, for each opponent, create a 1/1 red Goblin creature token that's tapped and attacking that player.

needs.what: `create_token` should accept `attacking` as a player spec -- e.g. `{"binding": "each_player"}` -- so a token can be created attacking a named player. Here the naming player is the one a `for_each_player` loop is currently on, which is exactly what "for each opponent, ... attacking that player" means: at a pod the three tokens are declared against three different seats, one each.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `attacking` is a bare boolean and `ops_board._attack_target` resolves it as `combat.attackers.get(ctx.source_oid)` -- the single player the *source* is attacking -- so every token in the loop would be pointed at that one seat no matter which opponent the iteration is on, and `for_each_player` would degenerate into "make N tokens all attacking the same player". Worse, this trigger fires on the commander swinging alone: when Ainok Strike Leader is not itself an attacker the lookup returns None, and the tokens arrive tapped but attacking nobody, silently dropping the whole clause while looking implemented. `for_each_player` already binds the right player as `each_player` and `primitives.create_token` already takes `attacking: int | None`; there is no key on the op to pass it through. `put_onto_battlefield`'s `attacking` is the same boolean resolved by `_attack_defender`, which falls back to an arbitrary attacker and is not token creation anyway. The rest of the card is expressible today: the trigger is `you_attack` with `condition` `{"exists": {"attacking": true, "controller": "you", "any_of": [{"self_only": true}, {"is_commander": true}]}}` (the documented `any_of` idiom for "it and/or your commander"), the token id `goblin_1_1_r` exists, `tapped: true` is "tapped", and the second line is an activated ability with a `sacrifice` cost and `grant_keyword` indestructible over `{"controller": "you", "types": ["Creature"], "is_token": true, "count": "all"}`.
